note: Summaries in own words from Meru Tantra Vol 1 Hindi bhashya. Short PD verse quotes only. Full rituals unlock via in-game guru, symbolic on-screen.

tabs.what: Mahakala's panchami-muktiTeaching strung like the central Meru bead of a mala; supreme among 108 tantras like Sumeru among mountains.
tabs.how_in_game: Main quest hub named Meru; each completed sadhana adds a bead to your mala UI.
tabs.philosophy: One thread (liberation) holds diverse beads (deities, paths). Unity without uniformity.

tabs.what: Ganapatya, Saura, Shakta, Vaishnava, Shaiva worship one all-faced Bhagavan; Kali is Krishna, Krishna is Kalika; the world is Shiva-Shakti-maya.
tabs.how_in_game: Ishta-devata picker (Bhadrakali default for Kolathiri temple); other paths bless same XP.
tabs.philosophy: Difference of names is the devotee's short sight; rivers differ, ocean one.

tabs.what: Guru needs ~20 virtues (pure conduct, mantra-vidhana knower, dayalu, shanta, desha-kala knower); disciple needs sincerity, not greed; greedy guru + siddhi-hungry disciple both fail, says text.
tabs.how_in_game: Two gurus: Tantri-guru (temple) and Kalari-gurukkal (Tamil Agama/Agastyar/Siddha body lore). Diksha quiz gates progress.
tabs.philosophy: Initiation is knowledge that burns sin; an undone guide cannot lift another.

tabs.what: 3 pre-birth + 10 life + 3 rites; plus mantra refinings: birth, enlivening, striking-awake, awareness, abhisheka, cleansing, nourishing, tarpana, kindling, concealing.
tabs.how_in_game: Mantra-crafting track: each refining raises mantra accuracy/stability before purashcharana.
tabs.philosophy: Sound, like a person, needs birth, food, bath and secrecy to mature.

tabs.what: Mandapa types, vedi, kunda measures: square, circle, hexagon, octagon, 5/7/8-cornered; vastu-puja; shubha masa/nakshatra/tithi/vara/yoga/karana/lagna; dream-omen check; sarvatobhadra + varuna mandalas.
tabs.how_in_game: Temple-build quests: raise mandapa, dig kunda shapes, pick muhurta on calendar, dream reading night event.
tabs.philosophy: Space and time are prepared vessels; the rite pours into readiness.

tabs.what: Sattvika/rajasa/tamasa mantras; 18 kunda rites; agni-sthapana; eight-petal worship-seat in pit center; tantrika homa order.
tabs.how_in_game: Homa checklist minigame; sattvika fire = calm buffs, rajasa = sharp, tamasa = heavy cost.
tabs.philosophy: Fire eats form and returns light; offering is metabolism of desire.

tabs.what: Bath, tilaka, tantric sandhya, Shiva-gayatri, vessel setup, bhuta-shuddhi (element cleansing), prana-pratishtha, inner/outer matrika nyasa, deity dhyana in both margas, Ganesha-mala, yogapitha, shalagrama by sect, avahana, puja, lamp-gift, food-gift, spirit-balance, triple worship.
tabs.how_in_game: Daily loop UI in temple/kalari/forest; streaks grant steadiness (siddhi-sthira).
tabs.philosophy: Day itself is the mandala; purification precedes invitation.

tabs.what: Kala, Keshavadi, Shrikanthadi, Bhuvaneshvari/Lakshmi/Kama/Shakti-Shri-Kama/Ganesha matrika sets + prapancha-yaga; sound placed on limbs before worship.
tabs.how_in_game: Tap-sequence puzzles per set; correct order unlocks dhyana verse.
tabs.philosophy: Body becomes the rosary; letters become limbs of the deity.

tabs.what: Pre-duties, fit place, fit mala (rudraksha glory, karma-mala, rules for all), forbidden acts during count, asana rules + banned seats, diet, time, siddhi means; Shabara track; japa itself is liberation-vehicle.
tabs.how_in_game: Mala counter with place/bead/seat/diet buffs; Shabara = kali-age fast track.
tabs.philosophy: Repetition is the chisel; count is the mallet.

tabs.what: Peace-rites plus stambhana (arrest), and harsher listed rites; damanotsava, pavitraropana; steadiness practices.
tabs.how_in_game: Playable: shanti heal, stambhana shield, uchchatana repel saboteurs. Listed harsher rites appear in philosophy tab only, never castable.
tabs.philosophy: Power must be fenced; siddhi without steadiness rots.

tabs.what: ~100 seals (inviting, placing, presenting, armor, weapons, animals, goddesses) plus welcome/water/foot-water/sip/honey-bath/cloth/jewel/thread/scent/flower/smoke/lamp/food/morsel/breaths sequence.
tabs.how_in_game: Gesture-trace minigame per seal; 16-step offering loop is the core temple interaction.
tabs.philosophy: Hands speak first; hospitality precedes theology.

tabs.what: Kula = Kundalini Shakti, Akula = Maheshvara; knowing this makes one knower; prana is the Thread holding worlds.
tabs.how_in_game: Dwaja-mast overlay shows mooladhara→sahasrara; breath bar visualizes rise symbolically.
tabs.philosophy: Meru the mountain, Meru the bead, Meru the spine — one axis.

tabs.what: Special lamp-offering rite to Kartavirya for lost-and-found, protection of goods and travelers.
tabs.how_in_game: Night escort quest: light row lamps to unlock safe-travel buff for supply runs.
tabs.philosophy: Light lent to others returns as road.

tabs.what: Unlike books that mock the other side, this text treats both margas with equal weight; pashu/vira/divya/kaula are temperaments, and the guru assigns by nature.
tabs.how_in_game: Path choice changes flavor text and helpers, never power; adult-gated Vama track is symbolic (flower/water, text verse, fade-to-black).
tabs.philosophy: Sattvika, rajasika, tamasika natures need different doors into one house.
